recommendation: A genuine C-suite transformation mandate with founder proximity, enterprise operating-model ownership and AI-enabled scaling; the key question is whether your transformation record translates credibly from marketing and commercial platforms into enterprise-wide strategy and operating governance.
whyNow: MSM Unify describes an inflection point involving rapid scaling, IPO readiness and new vertical launches across 50 markets.
primaryDriver: Turn founder priorities into measurable enterprise transformation and scalable operating discipline.
primaryRisk: The role expects enterprise-wide strategy, finance and operating-model breadth beyond a marketing transformation remit.
hiringRisk: How much direct enterprise-wide transformation, founder-office governance and cross-functional operating authority is required versus transferable transformation leadership?
positioning: Your multi-market transformation work, Salesforce migration and operating-model leadership provide a credible transformation platform.
The case must distinguish direct enterprise transformation evidence from adjacent marketing, CRM and commercial transformation experience.

requirements.requirement: 15+ years in strategy, transformation, consulting or leadership roles
requirements.reasoning: The candidate has more than 20 years of documented senior leadership experience.

requirements.requirement: Proven execution of large-scale transformation initiatives
requirements.reasoning: The record includes multi-market CRM migration, capability building and operating-model transformation.

requirements.requirement: AI, digital transformation and operational scaling expertise
requirements.reasoning: Digital and platform transformation are evidenced, while enterprise AI transformation breadth is less direct.

requirements.requirement: Experience working with founders, CEOs and senior leadership
requirements.reasoning: Senior stakeholder work is evidenced, but a formal founder-office operating role is not.

requirements.requirement: Business acumen across operations, finance and growth
requirements.reasoning: Commercial and growth accountability are strong; enterprise finance and operations breadth requires calibration.
The candidate has led work across 13 APAC and Middle East markets.

mandatePriorities: Act as the strategic extension of the Founder and drive execution of group priorities and growth roadmap.
Lead enterprise-wide transformation, restructuring, operating-model design and organizational alignment.
Drive AI adoption and automation across functions with measurable commercial outcomes.
Establish governance cadence, KPIs, dashboards and performance-management discipline.
Support expansion, partnerships, M&A due diligence and integration across a global platform.
mandateOutcomes: Create a scalable global operating model with stronger accountability, execution speed and measurable transformation outcomes.
openQuestions: How much direct authority does the CSTO hold over operating units, finance and functional leaders?
What evidence of enterprise AI transformation is expected at entry?
executiveThesis: The mandate is broader than marketing transformation: it is a founder-adjacent enterprise execution role spanning operating model, AI adoption, governance and expansion.
